newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentine energy companies start.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentine energy companies start.

text.p: -- ING Barings said on Tuesday it had started coverage of four Argentine oil and gas and conglomerate companies.
-- Barings analysts Hernan Ladeuix and Kathleen Breitenbach rated Perez Companc S.A. a buy, YPF S.A. a hold, and Sociedad Comercial del Plata and Astra C.A.P.S.A. sells.

They said Perez Companc was "expected to see net income increase in 1997 (excluding 1996 extraordinary gains), fueled by earnings from future projects in potential growth areas, such as power generation, petrochemicals and energy."

Breitenbach set a "year-end 1997 price target of 8.15 pesos per (American Depositary Receipt), implying 13 percent appreciation and market outperformance from current levels." Perez Companc was trading up 0.90 to 7.45 in Buenos Aires.
YPF "has attractive medium- and long-term prospects and is poised to profit from the region's future energy developments and privatization process."
Ladeuix set a 1997 year-end price target of $30 a share. YPF was up 3/8 to 27-3/4 in Tuesday trade in New York.
Astra's "net earnings should drop to $49 million in 1997, down from $52 million in 1996, and the company is not expected to see earnings grow until 1999 and 2000," the analysts wrote.
"Astra is overvalued by 20 to 25 percent and is expected to underperform the market in the next year." The company's shares were up 0.020 to 2.020 in Buenos Aires.

Sociedad Comercial del Plata's future earnings "are threatened by rising financial costs related to its increasing debt burden and ... uncertainty regarding the profitability of the company's new entertainment investment at Tren de la Costa."

Breitenbach said the company was "trading at a premium in a range of 27 to 63 percent according to a breakdown by business valuation and appears fully valued. We have set a year-end target price of 2.40 pesos per local share."
The company's shares were up 0.080 to 2.730 in Buenos Aires.
